items.headline: Burton, Reid connect on 43-yard TD to send UAB to comeback win against Louisiana Monroe
items.description: — Ryder Burton threw a 43-yard touchdown to EJ Reid with 9:34 left and UAB held on to beat Louisiana Monroe 26-20 on Saturday.

items.headline: Katin Houser throws 3 TD passes and runs for a score as Illinois beats UAB 42-23 in season opener
items.description: — Katin Houser threw three touchdown passes and ran for a score in his Illinois debut as the Illini defeated UAB 42-23 on Thursday night in a season opener.
